Every component now reads labels, colors, predicates, and sort logic from one place instead of duplicating inline maps.\n\n\| New file \| Purpose \|\n\|---\|---\|\n\| `lib/crm/index.ts` \| Barrel export \|\n\| `lib/crm/stages.ts` \| Stage definitions + `badgeClass` (was missing) \|\n\| `lib/crm/sources.ts` \| Lead source labels, short codes, chip styles, alias resolution \|\n\| `lib/crm/types.ts` \| Lead type / project category labels \|\n\| `lib/crm/temperature.ts` \| Hot/Warm/Cold thresholds, dot + badge classes \|\n\| `lib/crm/views.ts` \| Saved-view predicates (Today, Hot, Needs action, Quiet, Won this month) \|\n\| `lib/crm/sorts.ts` \| Sort comparators (score, newest, oldest, name, stage) \|\n\| `lib/crm/nav.ts` \| CRM sidebar navigation manifest \|\n\| `lib/crm/kpis.ts` \| KPI card specs with compute functions \|\n\n### Components updated to consume the manifest\n\n- `LeadCard.tsx` — uses `getCrmSource()` + `getCrmTemperature()` instead of inline maps\n- `LeadListView.tsx` — uses `CRM_STAGE_LABELS`, `CRM_STAGE_BADGE_CLASSES`, `getCrmSourceLabel()`, `getCrmLeadTypeLabel()`, `applyCrmSavedView()`\n- `LeadToolbar.tsx` — iterates `CRM_SOURCES`, `CRM_STAGES`, `CRM_TEMPERATURES` for dropdowns\n- `LeadTable.tsx` — uses `CRM_STAGE_BADGE_CLASSES` + `CRM_TEMPERATURES`\n- `AdminLeads.tsx` — uses `CRM_SAVED_VIEWS` predicates, `CRM_SORTS` comparators, `CRM_KPIS` compute, `CRM_SOURCES` for filter dropdown\n\n### Eliminated duplication\n\n- `SOURCE_LABELS` was defined in 4 files → now 0 (all read from `getCrmSourceLabel`)\n- `TYPE_LABELS` was defined in 2 files → now 0 (all read from `getCrmLeadTypeLabel`)\n- `STAGE_LABELS` was defined in 2 files → now 0 (all read from `CRM_STAGE_LABELS`)\n- `STATUS_COLORS` was defined in 3 files → now 0 (all read from `CRM_STAGE_BADGE_CLASSES`)\n- `SOURCE_CHIP` inline map in LeadCard → now 0 (reads from `getCrmSource`)\n- Saved-view filter predicates were inline in AdminLeads → now shared via `views.ts`\n- Sort comparators were inline switch-case → now `sorts.ts`\n- KPI compute logic was inline JSX → now `kpis.ts`\n\n---\n\n## Previous Iteration: **v2-action-first-crm**\n\n**Git commit:** `9419af68` — `feat(crm): Phase 1 action-first CRM transformation`\n**Date:** 2026-05-28\n\n### What's live now\n\n\| Component \| State \|\n\|---\|---\|\n\| **LeadCard.tsx** \| Redesigned: source chip (color-coded), temperature glow border, requirement one-liner, budget/city chips, quick-action bar (Call/WA/Email/View/Move) on hover \|\n\| **LeadPipeline.tsx** \| Meaningful stage labels (New Inquiry → Won/Lost), wider columns (260–280px), softer visual styling \|\n\| **LeadListView.tsx** \| Consistent stage labels via `STAGE_LABELS` map, complete `STATUS_COLORS` for all 9 stages \|\n\| **admin-theme.css** \| Warmer background (`225 20% 6%` ≈ `#0E1118`), increased text contrast, card elevation shadows, slightly larger typography \|\n\| **AdminLeads.tsx** \| Operations-focused KPI row: Leads Today, Hot Leads, Unassigned, Stale, Conversion %, Pipeline Value \|\n\| **CrmModule.tsx** \| Renamed to \"Lead Operations Center\", tab label \"Pipeline Board\" \|\n\| **TopBar.tsx** \| Logout button recolored: red → neutral grey (F-01 fix) \|\n\| **AdminLayout.tsx** \| Footer telemetry hidden for non-admin roles; \"modules\" → \"sections\"; removed Audit Logs link from footer (F-20 fix) \|\n\n### Design properties\n- **Background:** near-black navy-gray `hsl(225, 20%, 6%)` — NOT pure black\n- **Primary accent:** gold/amber `hsl(var(--admin-primary))`\n- **Logout button:** neutral grey (was red — red is now reserved for truly urgent items only)\n- **Card actions:** visible on hover via quick-action bar\n- **Stage labels:** Human-readable (New Inquiry, Contact Attempted, Interested, Req. Gathering, Proposal Sent, Negotiation, Final Review, Won, Lost)\n- **KPI row:** 6 operations-focused metrics replacing abstract totals\n- **Footer:** Simplified — technical telemetry (storage, module count) admin-only\n\n---\n\n## Previous Iteration: **v1-original-crm**\n\n**State before changes (pre-2026-05-28)**\n\n\| Component \| State \|\n\|---\|---\|\n\| **LeadCard** \| Name, email, phone, city, budget tier badge, \"Stale — 43d no activity\" warning, relative time. No source badge, no assignee, no next-action \|\n\| **LeadPipeline** \| 7 raw columns (NEW, CONTACTED, QUALIFIED, CONSULTATION, PROPOSAL SENT, NEGOTIATION, FINAL REVIEW). Narrow columns (~150px) \|\n\| **admin-theme.css** \| Pure black background, lower text contrast, smaller typography \|\n\| **AdminLeads KPIs** \| 4 abstract cards: Total Leads, Hot Leads, Stale, Pipeline Value \|\n\| **CrmModule** \| Title \"CRM & Lead Pipeline\" \|\n\| **TopBar** \| Logout button in red \|\n\| **AdminLayout footer** \| Full telemetry visible to all users: \"System Connected · 67.2 MB of 20GB used · 8 modules active\" \|\n\n### Known issues at v1\n- All 14 leads showed as stale\n- \"Hot Leads\" = 0 with no explanation\n- \"Pipeline Value\" = em-dash (no data)\n- 6 of 7 danger all red)\n- Footer showed technical telemetry to trainees\n\n---\n\n## Planned: **v3-blueprint-full-redesign** (Week 1–6 Rollout)\n\nBased on: [CRM_UX_Audit_and_Redesign_Blueprint.md](file:///C:/Users/aayus/Downloads/CRM_UX_Audit_and_Redesign_Blueprint.md)\n\n### Architectural decisions locked\n1. **Stages:** Collapse 9 → 5 in DB + UI (New → In Conversation → Meeting Planned → Quote Sent → Closing → Won/Lost)\n2. **Navigation:** Promote CRM sections to top-level sidebar items (Today, Inbox, Leads, Tasks, Reports, Settings)\n3. **Default landing:** `/admin/crm` → Today page (not Pipeline)\n\n### Remaining Week 1 fixes (Completed)\n\| Status \| ID \| Description \|\n\|---\|---\|---\|\n\| [x] \| **F-01** \| Recolor logout button (`admin-danger` → neutral) \|\n\| [x] \| **F-05** \| Inline help tooltips for ambiguous KPIs \|\n\| [x] \| **F-06** \| Replace Pipeline Value `—` with nudge (\"No budgets set\") \|\n\| [x] \| **F-13** \| Auto-capitalize names on capture \|\n\| [x] \| **F-14** \| Lowercase & validate emails \|\n\| [x] \| **F-16** \| Reformat budget display (`₹ Essential...` → `Budget: ₹15L`) \|\n\| [x] \| **F-20** \| Hide footer telemetry from non-admins \|\n\| [x] \| **F-22** \| Red overuse audit (Neutralized Logout, Unassigned, No-action) \|\n\n### Future weeks\n- **Week 2:** Vocabulary swap site-wide, empty states, InlineHelp component\n- **Week 3:** 5-stage pipeline (DB migration), stale banner, saved view chips, always-visible action buttons\n- **Week 4:** \"Today\" page as new default landing\n- **Week 5:** 3-step Add Lead wizard with source-aware fields\n- **Week 6:** Inbox page, Reports with PDF export, onboarding tour\n\n---\n\n## Revert Instructions\n\n- **Revert to v1-original-crm:** `git revert 9419af68` (undoes Phase 1 commit)\n- **Revert only LeadCard:** restore `LeadCard.tsx` from the commit before `9419af68`\n- **Revert only theme:** restore `admin-theme.css` from the commit before `9419af68`\n",` |

| 191 | `Raw HSL/RGB Color` | `hsl(var(--admin-border)` in `"content": "# UI/UX Audit: Admin Hub Module Cards\n\n**Status**: 🔴 High Improvement Potential\n**Focus**: Aesthetic refinement, Accessibility, and Information Architecture\n\n## 1. Executive Summary\nThe current Hub Module Cards in `AdminHub.tsx` follow a \"Strict 3-Zone\" layout. While technically functional and data-dense, the design feels clinical, overly compressed, and \"uninviting.\" The small typography and crowded interaction areas contribute to a \"Beginner/Freelancer-level\" aesthetic that lacks the premium, spacious feel expected of a modern administrative \"Intelligence Hub.\"\n\n## 2. Dimensional Audit\n\n\| Dimension \| Current State \| Issue \| Severity \|\n\| :--- \| :--- \| :--- \| :--- \|\n\| **Typography** \| 13px Serif Titles, 11px Muted Labels \| Font sizes are below optimal readability thresholds. Mix of Serif/Sans is inconsistent. \| 🟠 Medium \|\n\| **Information Density** \| 7-9 elements per card (Title, Icon, Badge, Desc, 2 Stats, Insight, CTA, Arrow) \| Excessive visual noise. Users struggle to find a primary focal point. \| 🔴 High \|\n\| **Iconography** \| 14px (w-3.5) icons \| Icons are lost in the layout; they fail to act as recognizable visual anchors. \| 🟠 Medium \|\n\| **Spacing** \| Tight gaps (gap-2.5), rigid border compartments \| Lack of \"white space\" makes the UI feel heavy and claustrophobic. \| 🔴 High \|\n\| **Accessibility** \| 11px muted text, tight leading \| Low contrast and small sizes hinder accessibility for users with visual impairments. \| 🟠 Medium \|\n\n## 3. Structural Flaws\n\n### A. The \"Compartmentalization\" Problem\nThe card is split into three distinct zones with visible borders. This \"boxed-in\" approach creates a fragmented visual experience. Modern \"Premium\" designs favor integrated flows where data sections bleed into each other naturally.\n\n### B. Scalability Bottleneck\nAs modules grow, the \"Insight Chip\" (Bell/Activity icons) starts competing with the \"Quick Stats\" grid. This creates a vertical stack that is too tall for a standard dashboard grid, leading to inconsistent card heights.\n\n### C. Visual Stiffiness\nThe heavy reliance on `border-[hsl(var(--admin-border))]` and `bg-[hsl(var(--admin-card))]` creates a very \"flat\" experience. There is a lack of depth and atmospheric lighting that characterizes \"Elite\" interfaces.\n\n## 4. Proposed \"Elite\" Redesign (Phase 1)\n\n### Visual Changes:\n- **Atmospheric Depth**: Replace hard borders with soft, deep shadows and localized \"light leaks\" (glows) based on module priority.\n- **Icon Elevation**: Increase icon size to `w-5 h-5` (20px) and place them on \"glowing\" pods to create clear visual anchors.\n- **Typography Overhaul**:\n    - Title: `text-base` (16px) Sans-Serif or Modern Geometric Serif.\n    - Stats: `text-lg` (18px) Bold for values to emphasize data importance.\n- **Layout Integration**: Remove the rigid 3-zone borders. Use subtle background shifts or increased padding to separate sections.\n\n### Functional Changes:\n- **Progressive Disclosure**: Only show the most critical stat by default; others reveal on hover or via a \"More\" interaction.\n- **Action Consolidation**: Integrate the \"Arrow\" into the card's natural flow rather than a separate footer element.\n\n---\n**Next Step**: Implementation of the `ModuleTile` refactor in `AdminHub.tsx`.\n",` |

| 263 | `Raw HSL/RGB Color` | `rgba(200, 162, 95, 0.05)` in `"content": "# Executive Architectural Alignment & Aesthetics Refinement Plan\n## Bridging \"Dream Home Brief\" (kiro-p1/kiro-p2) with existing Discovery & Estimator Add-ons\n\n---\n\n### Executive Vision\n\nThis plan establishes a comprehensive strategy to harmonize the aesthetics, layout, and data pipelines of the **Style Discovery Engine** and the **Interior Cost Estimator**. By learning from the elite interactive UX of `kiro-p1` and `kiro-p2` (\"Dream Home Brief\"), we will transform our standalone style quiz into an intelligent, high-converting \"Client Clarity Funnel.\"\n\nThe objective is to unify their layouts, introduce tactile visual details (warm gold accents, procedurally layered grain noise, and score-reactive lighting), and seamlessly bridge the data-flow so that a client's aesthetic profile pre-populates the budget estimator instantly.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Structural Comparison & Core Learnings\n\nBelow is a detailed technical analysis comparing the target models (`kiro-p1` & `kiro-p2`) with our existing workspace add-ons.\n\n\| Aspect \| kiro-p1 / kiro-p2 (\"Dream Home Brief\") \| Existing Discovery Engine \| Existing Cost Estimator \| Actionable Target Architecture \|\n\| :--- \| :--- \| :--- \| :--- \| :--- \|\n\| **Primary Goal** \| Structured spatial, lifestyle, and project brief preparation. \| 5D Aesthetic Vector and Archetype Scoring (`[m, w, s, t, n]`). \| Instant, multi-tiered pricing estimation. \| **Unified Style-Clarity & Budget Estimator Engine**. \|\n\| **Layout Paradigm** \| Clean 2-panel grid or single-page view; `kiro-p2` implements a Left Progress Sidebar. \| 72px ultra-compact vertical Left Dot-Nav + Right-aligned quiz content. \| **Fixed 3-Panel Split**: Left (30% Context), Middle (10% Progress), Right (60% Form). \| **Universal 3-Panel Split**: Re-architect Discovery to use the Estimator's luxurious 30/10/60 structure. \|\n\| **Color System** \| Warm ink base (`#080808`, `#0f0f0f`) with luxury warm-gold accents (`#c8a96e`). \| Deep warm-ink (`bg-site-bg`, `#0F0F10`) with striking crimson (`#E35336`). \| Deep dark-mode theme, using crimson accents (`#E35336`) and border-lines. \| **Luxury Obsidian-Gold System**: Primary CTAs in crimson, secondary accents & states in premium Gold (`#c8a96e`). \|\n\| **Interactive Magic** \| Flat cards, option grids, clean text areas, active tag chips. \| Score-reactive ambient light grids, procedural grain overlay, floating particles. \| Horizontal progress bars, ready-state active pulsing buttons. \| **Immersive Tactile Experience**: procedural paper-noise, floating particles, and score-reactive glows on all views. \|\n\| **Conflict & Friction** \| Real-time **Conflict Engine** checking budget vs style, space vs area, cooking vs kitchen. \| None (smooth aesthetic questions). \| Instant validation alerts if fields are missing. \| **Advisory Banner / Clarity Check**: Integrate a visually stunning \"Reality Check\" phase into the style quiz. \|\n\n---\n\n## 2. Keyboard Navigation Integration (WCAG 2.1 AA)\n\nAll required interactive pattern implementations are complete:\n- ✅ `tabIndex={0}` + `role=\"button\"` on all custom interactive divs\n- ✅ `onKeyDown` → `Enter`/`Space` activation on all non-native interactive elements\n- ✅ `peer-focus-visible` pattern on custom range slider thumbs (EmotionalMapping)\n- ✅ SVG `focus-visible` ring on radar chart dots via CSS class\n- ✅ Focus trap + Escape key on all modal/overlay elements\n\n---\n\n## 4. Elite / FAANG-level Verdict\n\n### **Previous Score: Intermediate agency-level**\n\n### **Current Score: Professional production-level → Elite / FAANG-level**\nAll critical WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard navigation violations are resolved. Contrast ratios have been elevated to 4.8:1+ across all small text elements. The full brand logo is now displayed consistently in the discovery nav matching the site-wide design system. With keyboard ring states styled to match the premium brand palette (warm bronze `#8b6f47`), the experience is now beautiful AND inclusive.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Remaining Refinements (Optional Elite Polish)\n\n1. **Skip-to-content link**: Add a `<a href=\"#main-content\" className=\"sr-only focus:not-sr-only ...\">Skip to main content</a>` at the top of `DiscoveryPage` for enhanced keyboard navigation.\n2. **Live region for quiz progress**: Add `aria-live=\"polite\"` to the step counter so screen readers announce step changes.\n3. **Error state announcements**: Any validation states in `LeadGatePhase.tsx` should use `aria-describedby` linked to the error message.\n\n---\n\n*Report compiled by Principal Frontend & Accessibility Architect, Antigravity AI.*\n",` |
